items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Ruth Brown was their feature artist, and I wrote this thing Tear Drops Keep Falling From My Eyes

ctx.x: Have you got most of the guys that you recorded for, I mean that you made arrangements for, that you wrote for different guys?

Yeah. With Atlantic Records I was writing, and I was musical director for Atlantic Records, and at that time Ruth Brown was their feature artist, and I wrote this thing Tear Drops Keep Falling From My Eyes, which was a big over a million seller.
